_doc: 移动判定的结论文字(进模型的提示与拒绝理由,10-06)
unresolved: the move target is empty or cannot be resolved
no_route: no route between {a} and {b} on the world map; cannot go
to_gate: too far to cross towns: this turn reach {town}/{gate} ({gate_name}); next turn you can enter {next}
via: to reach {town} you pass through {next}: this turn reach {landing}, continue next turn
no_node_gate: {town} has no node '{node}'; this turn you land at the gate {gate} (valid nodes e.g.: {some})
